findings.summary: An answer message writes no idempotency record, so a key first used for an answer and reused with a different message is routed anew rather than refused KEY_REUSED; matches ADR 0023 section 4 (answers replay through input_replayed).

Two identical concurrent answers can both pass input_replayed; the run-revision compare-and-set accepts one and gives the other CONFLICT, not a replay. Exactly one input is accepted; the window predates Phase 4.
Conversation updated_at uses utc_now()/now() rather than the injected clock; paging orders by created_at.
The coordinator imports the private _Turns from kernel/context to build the shadow comparison layer.
